gates.evidence: Real Chrome cross-origin fixture proves readable CORS allow, rejected CORS deny, and opaque no-cors response.
Browser and contract courts reject URL credentials, backslashes and encoded-host ambiguity after canonicalization; path capabilities are segment-aware.
Browser opaque redirects fail closed; integration court re-authorizes every visible redirect target before fetch and blocks widened target scope.
Declared Chrome profile probes Local Network Access behavior and exercises a loopback fixture; canonicalized 127.0.0.1, 127.1, 2130706433 and ::1 spellings fail closed when local access is disabled.
Core exposes an explicit broker SSRF requirements contract while implementing no broker/open fetch proxy; direct-browser evidence is kept separate.
Chrome streamed response exceeds the decoded-byte budget with OC_OUTPUT_LIMIT; contract court proves misleading Content-Length cannot weaken the limit.
Chrome AbortSignal court rejects with AbortError and contract stream court confirms body-reader cancellation.
Secret plaintext remains authority-side; browser receives only an opaque handle, injection occurs inside NetworkAuthority, and receipts expose neither plaintext nor handle.
Browser enforces session/process/task scope; contract courts additionally enforce scheme/host/method/path/expiry.
Frozen package install rejects secret handles and lifecycle scripts remain denied by default.
Browser diagnostics/support court injects Authorization, Cookie, signed query and response-body canaries and proves no secret leakage.
Real provider-style HTTP 401 leaves canonical workspace generation and bytes unchanged.
External networking is denied after Offline downgrade while the Service Worker virtual preview route remains operational.

Service Worker preview proof binds owner+epoch plus workspace/session/version identity; tampering each identity field independently returns 409. Compatibility ID v2 prevents reuse of legacy workers lacking this proof.
Real Service Worker virtual HTTP court covers HEAD, Range/206+Content-Range, redirect, response headers and abort.
Trusted preview edge strips credential headers before untrusted dispatch; sandboxed hostile srcdoc has opaque origin and cannot read parent canary or host localStorage.
Offline, Registry-only, Restricted and Open-web profiles are frozen; an existing authority can only move monotonically to a more restrictive profile.
Every allow/deny decision carries deterministic policyVersion and policyHash; browser court verifies retained identity.

boundaries: Evidence is for the declared direct-browser Chrome 153 / Ubuntu 24.04 x64 profile only.
Core does not implement or claim a production broker fetch proxy; broker SSRF requirements remain a separate future trust boundary.
This is not a cross-browser Windows/macOS/mobile matrix.
This is not weak-device, long-run plateau, production-CDN/topology, public-release identity, legal/FTO or operations closure.
